requirement: Change the tie-break between runs with the same largest sum: prefer the shortest run (fewest elements), and among equally short runs the one with the smallest start. (Previously the smallest start won, then the smallest end.)
desc: Find the non-empty contiguous run of xs with the largest sum. Return (sum, start, end), where start and end are the 0-based indices of its first and last element (end inclusive). If several runs share the largest sum, choose the shortest one (fewest elements); among equally short ones, the one with the smallest start. Return nothing if xs is empty.
